## Forms · Close JR Task → `n8n_closeJrTask(actor, idOrWorkflow, notes)`
**Drop-in replacement for the `doPost completeJrTitle` call** ("Mark Portal JR Complete" in *BOSS JR Assignment*).
- `idOrWorkflow`: a task id `TK-…` (tracker sheet column K, `portalTicketId`) **or** a workflow id `NEW_EMP_…` (resolves the single open `jr_title` task).
- `notes`: optional; default "JR title verified & assigned via n8n".
Effect is identical to a human clicking *Complete* in ActionItemForm (checklist item "Verify and assign JR title" marked Complete, closedBy = actor email, downstream effects fire).
Returns `{ taskId, workflowId, success … }`. Re-closing returns `{ ok:true, alreadyClosed:true }` unless `treatAlreadyClosedAsSuccess:false`.
The `jr_title` task only exists after **IT Setup** has been submitted for the workflow; before that you get `EFX E_NOT_FOUND`.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
